failureReason: The model attempted to implement prefetch-until-navigation functionality but failed to correctly structure the component hierarchy to use the navigation() function as a gating mechanism. The build succeeded, but EVAL.ts tests fail because: (1) navigation() import is missing, (2) the title is not gated properly for prefetch, and (3) project details are fetched before navigation() instead of after. The model spent significant effort researching the pattern but did not correctly apply it in the code.
